parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift` within the `Playback` package. Although the methods `stopTransitionsToIdle` (line 71) and `isPlayingFalseAfterStop` (line 88) share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.78), they are distinct test cases asserting different post-stop invariants — one verifies the idle state transition and the other verifies the `isPlaying` flag — so their near-duplication is intentional and expected in a test suite. Collapsing them would obscure the separate behavioral assertions and reduce test clarity.
